messages:
riley: Heads-up 1 opening a docs PR to cover upgrade paths for customers moving from Dedicated -> Private when they have an HAProxy edge + WireGuard tunnel to on-prem KMS/HSM. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/UPG-100. Need review on the checklist, air-gap packaging, and smoke tests.

marco: Love this. Key things: show parallel staging (deploy proxy+wg on Private then mirror), include a toggle rollback plan (BGP route revert or ip rule remove), and a short example of a zero-downtime cutover with healthchecks.

zara: Also call out vendor-specific HSM management ports (some use 8443, others 7502). Add a small table mapping vendor -> known admin ports and recommended check command.

ops: For air-gapped sites: include an offline bundle manifest (binary, configs, certs, checksums) and a postinstall smoke script that validates: kernel module present, wg handshake, proxy listeners, and KMS admin TCP reachability. Recommend `exit 1` on failure so customer's orchestration can surface failure.

riley: Draft manifest I'm planning: `/opt/offline/redwood/upgrade-bundle/` with `bin/` (haproxy, wg), `config/` (haproxy.cfg, wg-kms.conf), `certs/` (proxy TLS + vendor certs), `scripts/` (postinstall.sh, smoke-check.sh), `checksums.txt`. I'll include sample sha256 sums and perms notes.

marco: For the smoke script, include these checks: `modprobe --dry-run` for required modules, `wg show` for handshake, `ss -tnlp` to confirm HAProxy/listeners, and `curl --interface <proxy-ip> -sS https://kms.example.com:7443/healthz`. If curl fails, capture `tcpdump -c 50 -w /tmp/kms-snap.pcap udp port 51820 or tcp port 7443`.

zara: Add clear remediation hints in the script output (e.g., "wg: no peers handshaking -> check UDP egress, ensure endpoint DNS resolves, check MTU"). Also add an explicit step for customers who must pre-enroll HSM vendor certs in an air-gapped environment (path + permissions).

ops: Small security ask: stamp the bundle with a signature file and show how to verify with `gpg --verify` on target. Include a note about rotating signing keys and revocation practice if a bundle is compromised.

riley: I'll add a sample `postinstall.sh` (non-executable snippet in docs) that runs smoke-check.sh and writes status to `/var/log/redwood/upgrade-status.log`. Planning to add a systemd unit for `redwood-upgrade.service` that runs once at the end of install and toggles a sentinel file on success.

marco: For cutover steps include: 1) Deploy proxy+wg in Private in parallel 2) Mirror compute (if applicable) or test from a staging host 3) Run smoke script and validate 4) Shift route (BGP or ip rule) to new proxy 5) Monitor for 30m then remove old route and decommission old proxy. Provide commands for `ip rule add` and `ip rule del` for quick rollback.

zara: Also include a troubleshooting matrix (symptom / likely cause / quick checks): e.g. "No KMS admin reachability" -> false positive: firewall ACL; checks: `ss`, `traceroute -T`, `tcpdump`. "Intermittent token errors" -> MTU or fragmentation; checks: `ping -M do -s`, `wg show` for dropped packets.

riley: Draft smoke-check.sh snippet I'll include: `#!/bin/bash
set -e
# 1) verify wg handshake
if ! wg show | grep -q "latest handshake"; then echo "FAIL: wg handshake"; exit 1; fi
# 2) verify proxy listening
if ! ss -tnlp | grep -q haproxy; then echo "FAIL: haproxy not listening"; exit 1; fi
# 3) verify KMS admin plane
if ! curl --interface $1 -sS --fail https://kms.example.com:7443/healthz >/dev/null; then echo "FAIL: KMS admin unreachable"; tcpdump -c 50 -w /tmp/kms-snap.pcap tcp port 7443 || true; exit 1; fi
echo "OK: smoke checks passed"
`

ops: Suggest env var checks and richer logging: accept `--proxy-ip` and `--wg-iface` flags, dump `wg show` to a timestamped file on failure, and emit JSON status to stdout for orchestration.

marco: Docs nit: include expected minimal `wg show` output snippet and expected `ss` lines so customers can compare. Also include guidance for MTU tuning: start with 1420 for WireGuard and test with `ping -s`.

zara: For the vendor port table, I'll coordinate with solutions-eng to fill in known ports. We'll mark entries "vendor-provided" and recommend verifying with vendor.

riley: Great. I'll update the PR to add: manifest example, postinstall & smoke scripts, systemd unit, cutover checklist, troubleshooting matrix, and bundle signing instructions. Adding "needs eng-sre smoke" to PR checklist.

docs-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/UPG-100 (files changed: docs/private/upgrade-path-proxy-wg.md, examples/upgrade-bundle-layout.md, scripts/smoke-check.sh, snippets/systemd-redwood-upgrade.service)

ops: One last thing: include a short rollback automation snippet that runs `ip rule del` and `ip route flush table wgroute` and verify `curl` from a control host to confirm traffic flows back to old proxy.

riley: Thanks everyone. I'll ping when PR is ready for final review and tag eng-sre for the smoke test on a Secure Boot enabled VM (if applicable).
